messages.content: Calculate the volume of the sphere with radius 3 units.

function.name: calculate_park_area
function.description: Calculate the total area of a park based on the radius of its circular part. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

radius.description: The radius of the circular part of the park. This is a float type value.

shape.description: The shape of the park. Default is 'circle'.

message.content:
The volume \(V\) of a sphere with radius \(r\) is given by  

\[
V=\frac{4}{3}\pi r^{3}.
\]

For \(r = 3\) units:

\[
V = \frac{4}{3}\pi(3)^3 = \frac{4}{3}\pi(27) = 36\pi \text{ cubic units}.
\]

Numerically,

\[
36\pi \approx 36 \times 3.14159 \approx 113.10 \text{ cubic units}.
\]
message.reasoning: The user asks: "Calculate the volume of the sphere with radius 3 units." We have a tool function calculate_park_area but it's for area of a park based on radius of its circular part. That seems unrelated. There's no function for volume. So we cannot use the tool. We should respond with the calculation manually. Volume of sphere formula V = (4/3)πr^3. r=3 units. So V = (4/3)*π*27 = 36π. In numeric approximate: 36 * 3.14159 ≈ 113.097. So answer: 36π cubic units or about 113.1 cubic units.
